prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: high-end logo proposal board for a donut brand named Drachas. Create a new original professional minimalist visual identity. Exact brand spelling: "Drachas" (D-r-a-c-h-a-s), seven letters, capital D, lowercase rachas. Never write Donas Racha, Rachas alone, Rachaa, Dracha or any tagline. Preserve current brand colors: deep aubergine #100D17 background, soft lavender #C5A3EE main mark, off-white #FAF6FF lettering; optional tiny dusty pink #D986B4 accent. Flat vector-like construction, clean precise curves, balanced negative space, strong silhouette readable small, elegant geometric humanist sans-serif typography with careful kerning. No 3D, gradients, glossy effects, shadows, realistic pastries, mascot, face, sprinkles, flourishes, script font, stock badge, packaging, photos or watermarks. Landscape presentation board: one large horizontal brand lockup in the upper two thirds, and underneath two small pure monochrome tests of the identical symbol, lavender on dark and dark on off-white. Lots of breathing space. Labels only if specified. Keep the three tests geometrically identical to each other. Direction A: a donut whose round glazed upper bowl and single flowing icing extension form an unmistakable uppercase R. The donut hole is the counter of the R. Include a disciplined short vertical stem at left and a tasteful diagonal leg at lower right that seems poured from the icing, one continuous substantial silhouette. A tiny controlled icing lip suggests glaze, not multiple drips. Preserve the visible donut hole. Place this R-donut symbol beside the COMPLETE text Drachas; the symbol is separate, do not replace the D or omit any letters. The result must communicate both donut and R without cartoon decoration. Do not add a second conventional R outside the word. Small top-left proposal label exactly "A · R glaseada".
